feed.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Daniela has demonstrated consistent engagement as a reviewer over the course of 30, 60, and 90-day periods, positioning her as a promising candidate for an elevated reviewing role within the repository. Her ongoing activity sets her apart as a reliable contributor who maintains a regular presence and involvement in the review process.
In contrast, Edil has provided technically sound reviews, but these contributions have occurred over a more extended period and lack the steady frequency observed in Daniela’s recent activity. This distinction underscores the value placed on both the quality and consistency of participation when considering candidates for key roles in open-source projects.
The current role holder reflects on personal activity, noting a marked decline in contributions due to shifting focus towards other priorities, notably those documented at [https://github.com/roasbeef](https://github.com/roasbeef). Recognizing this shift and a reduced capacity to contribute meaningfully, there is a decision to vacate the position by year’s end. This transition opens an opportunity for someone like Daniela, whose active participation aligns with the evolving needs of the project and the community.
